description: RE-SCOPED (prototype-proven, fz-f98.14.10.2). The fix is TWO-PART, not a split into two identities: (1) addressed-alpha convergence_class — the recursive KEY holds structure by address (list(a_e), addressed callable-surface var) not the any/fun_top fallback; PROVEN to terminate + dissolve partition/4 over-spec + keep the reducer resolvable. (2) THE KEYSTONE: a transport-side resolution seam that resolves an activation-key address var's element/surface back to the ActivationInputs evidence layout when deriving ShapeId/boundary. Part 1 alone breaks transport (+9 lib/+3 matrix) because transport consumes the key as a ground layout and there is no address->evidence resolution today. Build (2) FIRST (or together); then (1) lands and dissolves the convergence family (reducer-any fz-f98.14.7, accumulator-widening, partition fz-f98.14.7.2.2, and this split). = [[shapeid_is_pure_layout]]: the key is a dispatch-identity surface; making it also the layout surface requires the resolver that maps address->evidence.
title: Separate activation-key convergence-identity from transport-layout-identity
